mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DAILY_OPERATION_SUMMARY ( snapshotDate, snapshotAt, constructionCount, headquartersDeviceCount, franchiseDeviceCount, spareDeviceCount ) SELECT CURDATE(), NOW(), ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CONSTRUCTION CON INNER JOIN TB_GROUP GP ON GP.idx = CON.groupIdx WHERE CON.conduct = 0 AND CON.isDel = 0 ), ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DEVICE DEV INNER JOIN TB_CONSTRUCTION CON ON CON.id = DEV.constructionIdx INNER JOIN TB_GROUP GP ON GP.idx = CON.groupIdx WHERE DEV.conduct = 0 AND DEV.isDel = 0 AND CON.conduct = 0 AND CON.isDel = 0 ), ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DEVICE DEV INNER JOIN TB_CONSTRUCTION CON ON CON.id = DEV.constructionIdx INNER JOIN TB_GROUP GP ON GP.idx = CON.groupIdx WHERE DEV.conduct = 2 AND DEV.isDel = 0 AND CON.conduct = 0 AND CON.isDel = 0 ), ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SPARE_DEVICE SD INNER JOIN TB_CONSTRUCTION CON ON CON.id = SD.constructionIdx INNER JOIN TB_GROUP GP ON GP.idx = CON.groupIdx WHERE SD.type = 0 AND SD.status = 0 AND CON.conduct = 0 AND CON.isDel = 0 AND GP.isDel = 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE snapshotAt = VALUES(snapshotAt), constructionCount = VALUES(constructionCount), headquartersDeviceCount = VALUES(headquartersDeviceCount), franchiseDeviceCount = VALUES(franchiseDeviceCount), spareDeviceCount = VALUES(spareDeviceCount)
